LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_THREE.learnerPromise: Turn a direct statement into a friendly suggestion.
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_THREE.explanation: Put 吧 at the end of a sentence to make a suggestion.

teachingGlossary.meaning: to be located at; in; on
ending word for a yes/no question
a little food; something to eat

discoveryLab.title: Explore this pattern
discoveryLab.description: Put 吧 at the end of a sentence to make a suggestion.

choices.label: Book sentence 1
choices.traditional: 這個蛋糕太大，你買小的吧。
choices.simplified: 这个蛋糕太大，你买小的吧。
choices.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo tài dà nǐ mǎi xiǎo de ba.
choices.english: This cake is too large, you had better buy the small one.
choices.note: Compare the word order with the pattern table.

choices.label: Book sentence 2
choices.traditional: 那杯水太熱，你喝這杯吧。
choices.simplified: 那杯水太热，你喝这杯吧。
choices.pinyin: Nà bēi shuǐ tài rè, nǐ hē zhè bēi ba.
choices.english: That water is too hot; drink this cup instead.
choices.note: 吧 comes at the end of the suggestion.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Put 吧 at the end of a sentence to make a suggestion.

patternRows.english: This cake is too large, you had better buy the small one.

items.question: I want to suggest going together. 吧 or 嗎?
items.answer: 吧 makes a suggestion. 嗎 turns the same words into a yes/no question.

items.question: Where does 吧 go — at the start or the end?
items.answer: The very end. Say the whole suggestion first, then close with 吧.

right.english: Why don’t you drink this one?

text.traditional: 那杯水太熱，你喝這杯吧。
text.simplified: 那杯水太热，你喝这杯吧。
text.pinyin: Nà bēi shuǐ tài rè, nǐ hē zhè bēi ba.
text.english: That water is too hot; drink this cup instead.

text.traditional: A：你看這兩件衣服，紅的好看還是白的好看？ B：都很好看，這兩件妳都買吧。
text.simplified: A：你看这两件衣服，红的好看还是白的好看？ B：都很好看，这两件你都买吧。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ kàn zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu, hóng de hǎokàn háishì bái de hǎokàn? B: Dōu hěn hǎokàn, zhè liǎng jiàn nǐ dōu mǎi ba.
text.english: A: Look at these two pieces of clothing. Which looks better, the red one or the white one? B: Both look good. Buy both.

text.traditional: A：我想去圖書館看書。 B：我也想去，我們一起去吧。
text.simplified: A：我想去图书馆看书。 B：我也想去，我们一起去吧。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ xiǎng qù túshūguǎn kànshū. B: Wǒ yě xiǎng qù, wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba.
text.english: A: I want to read at the library. B: I do too. Let’s go together.

text.pinyin: A: Nǐ kàn zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu, hóng de hǎokàn háishì bái de hǎokàn? B: Dōu hěn hǎokàn, zhè liǎng jiàn nǐ dōu mǎi ba.
text.english: A: Look at these two pieces of clothing. Which looks better, the red one or the white one? B: Both look good. Buy both.

text.traditional: A：我想去圖書館看書。 B：我也想去，我們一起去吧。
text.simplified: A：我想去图书馆看书。 B：我也想去，我们一起去吧。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ xiǎng qù túshūguǎn kànshū. B: Wǒ yě xiǎng qù, wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba.
text.english: A: I want to read at the library. B: I do too. Let’s go together.

dialogue.title: 對話一 · Dialogue 1
dialogue.setting: 約週末下午茶 · Planning weekend afternoon tea

text.traditional: 友美，妳這個週末要做什麼？
text.simplified: 友美，你这个周末要做什么？
text.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ zhè ge zhōumò yào zuò shénme?
text.english: Youmei, what are you going to do this weekend?

text.traditional: 我要在家看書、聽音樂。
text.simplified: 我要在家看书、听音乐。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài jiā kànshū, tīng yīnyuè.
text.english: I am going to read and listen to music at home.

words.meaning: to be located at; in; on

text.traditional: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
text.simplified: 你星期六下午有空吗？我们一起去喝下午茶，怎么样？
text.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
text.english: Are you free Saturday afternoon? How about afternoon tea together?

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

text.traditional: 好啊！你想去哪裡？
text.simplified: 好啊！你想去哪里？
text.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
text.english: Sounds great! Where do you want to go?

text.traditional: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很好吃。
text.simplified: 我知道一家很不错的咖啡厅，那里的冰淇淋很好吃。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā hěn búcuò de kāfēitīng, nàlǐ de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī.
text.english: I know a nice café. The ice cream there is delicious.

text.traditional: 他們有巧克力冰淇淋嗎？
text.simplified: 他们有巧克力冰淇淋吗？
text.pinyin: Tāmen yǒu qiǎokèlì bīngqílín ma?
text.english: Do they have chocolate ice cream?

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

text.traditional: 有啊！他們有很多種冰淇淋。
text.simplified: 有啊！他们有很多种冰淇淋。
text.pinyin: Yǒu a! Tāmen yǒu hěn duō zhǒng bīngqílín.
text.english: Yes. They have many kinds of ice cream.

text.traditional: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
text.simplified: 我们这个星期六下午两点半去吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
text.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

text.traditional: 好。
text.simplified: 好。
text.pinyin: Hǎo.
text.english: Okay.
